Is My Therapist Frustrated With Me? | ScienceWorks
The broader relationship between you and your therapist is consistently linked to how well therapy goes, across hundreds of studies and many kinds of treatment [2][3]. That is why a strain is worth talking about, not hiding. Our specialized therapy page describes the approaches our clinicians use. Misconception 1: "A good therapist never feels frustrated." Therapists have their own reactions to clients.
